text: I feel as though I am standing in a space dedicated to curiosity and invention. The glass walls and bright lights lend an atmosphere of anticipation, as if I am about to witness or participate in a process of discovery. The R+D wall reminds me how human creativity continuously evolves. The lingering narration about the 'fishIR' and an old movie leaves me slightly disoriented, yet intrigued, as if I'm straddling the worlds of memory and innovation. I sense a gentle urge to explore further, to see what new ideas and connections await just around the corner.
